title: Architecture
description: Copy-once core starter kit, standalone template folders, and optional core propagation.

blocks.text: Each template under templates/ is a complete Next.js project that tempjs copies flat to client machines. packages/core is only the initial boilerplate — not an overlay layer and not an ongoing dependency.

rows: Shared auth/leads fix for all templates

blocks.title: Edit templates/ directly
blocks.text: Unlike the old overlay model, templates/hotel-website-template/ is the source of truth for the hotel product — not a generated folder you avoid touching.

items: templates/<name>/prisma/schema.prisma — merged output (regenerated on new-template or sync)

blocks.text: Domain logic lives in lib/features/<domain>/ with thin app/api routes. Legacy lib/controllers/* paths are re-exports for older imports.
Each template has its own constants/site.ts — brand, contact, SEO, theme colors, hero copy, admin labels. Core ships a stub; the template author replaces it with client-ready defaults.
See also: Core starter kit page for the full included-file list.
